name: branch-qa
displayName: Branch QA: headless E2E & functional QA
description: QA the current git branch against its ticket: maps what the change impacts (endpoints, UI forms, services, DB, callbacks, jobs, external APIs), plans success/invalid/validation/boundary/failure/edge-case scenarios, runs them headless (test runner, HTTP checks, browser, runtime tracer), pin-points the methods each ran through, marks passed/failed with remarks and fixes, and opens an HTML report with a copy-for-the-ticket results table.
